query: For my 56-year-old female, what's the 25th percentile of the first respiratory rate recorded at ICU/step-down admission (age 51–61)?
final_sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.25) within GROUP (ORDER BY value) AS percentile_25 FROM omr JOIN patients ON omr.subject_id = patients.subject_id JOIN icustays ON omr.subject_id = icustays.subject_id WHERE patients.gender = 'F' AND patients.anchor_age = 56 AND icustays.first_careunit IN ('ICU', 'Step-down') AND patients.anchor_year BETWEEN 51 AND 61;
